At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


Mission

Make the Everyday delivery system so predictable, documented and
self-explanatory that the Global Product Director never has to ask
"where is this?", "did they commit to that?", or "has anyone told the
regions how this works?" — and protect that focus by being the
single, credible filter between global demand and the product
leadership's attention.

Coverage: Daily overlap with CET and US Eastern is mandatory;
occasional APAC-friendly hours

Must have
8+ years in delivery or project management inside software product
organisations; at least 3 of those in a multi-vendor or outsourced delivery
setting.
Demonstrated ownership of Scrum or Kanban cadences across multiple
time zones and cultures.
A concrete, evidenced track record of raising work-item quality — able to
show a "before and after" of a backlog they cleaned up and the DoR/DoD
they enforced.
Vendor governance experience: commitment tracking, performance
conversations grounded in data, structured escalation.
Written English at near-native standard. This is fundamentally a writing
job: precise, unambiguous, executive-safe, no filler.
Strong structured reasoning: able to detect when an "update" contains no
facts, when an argument is circular, and when a date has no plan behind it.

Fluent in a work-tracking tool (Jira or Azure DevOps) and a documentation-
first culture. Notion strongly preferred.

Behavioural non-negotiables
Emotional maturity. Stays factual when others are not. Does not
personalise, does not escalate tone, does not gossip.
Factual by default. Reports what happened, not how it felt.
Comfortable being unpopular. Will reject a senior stakeholder's item for
failing DoR and will say no to scope entering mid-sprint.
Curiosity and product proximity. Uses Everyday. Has looked at the app,
the back office and the reports. We do not accept people who orchestrate a
process for a product they have never opened.
Learning posture. Actively wants to work in an AI-intensive environment
and will invest personal time to get good at it.
Discretion. Will see commercially and politically sensitive material.

 

AI fluency
We are not hiring an AI engineer. We are hiring an intensive AI user who will
operate inside an AI-heavy Notion workspace and is expected to become
materially faster because of it. Candidates should be able to describe,
concretely, a workflow they have already automated or accelerated with AI and
what it saved.

Mandatory skills:

  • 5+ years of experience working as a full stack developer ( front & backend)

  • Java and Javascript development experience

  • Typescript development experience

  • Experience with frameworks & Runtime: Spring Boot, React , Node.js , Redux and Hooks

  • Swift, Xcode and SwiftUI, shipping production iOS applications

  • Deep knowledge of software design patterns

  • Experience developing applications with complex business logic

  • Knowledge of Agile’s methodologies

  • Development of Unit Testing 

  • Fluent or advanced English Skills (all communications are being held in English)

  • Familiarity with agentic software development

Important skills:

  • Hexagonal architecture and Domain Driven Design 

  • CI/CD platform knowledge

  • API-First knowledge or work experience, with OpenAPI-generated clients and servers

  • Backend-for-frontend aggregation patterns, composing many upstream services into client-shaped contracts

  • Spring Data JPA and relational persistence; MariaDB or PostgreSQL

  • Knowledge or work experience with cache systems (Caffeine, Redis or similar)

  • Integration testing, and service virtualisation to keep those tests hermetic

  • Clean Architecture on mobile: domain / data / presentation separation, MVVM, Coordinator-driven navigation

  • Swift Package Manager, and experience modularising an app into shared packages

  • Combine and Swift Concurrency (async/await)

  • JUnit 5, Mockito and AssertJ; XCTest and XCUITest; Jest and React Testing Library

  • CI/CD platform knowledge

  • GitHub Actions, static analysis quality gates, and Fastlane for mobile build and release lanes

  • Gitflow and trunk-based development

  • Knowledge or work experience with monitoring and alerting tools; the stack here is Grafana, plus Application Insights on the client side

  • Monitoring and observability, Grafana across metrics, logs and traces (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo), and Azure Application Insights for client-side telemetry and crash reporting. Comfort reading a dashboard, querying logs and following a trace across services is expected, not optional

Valued skills:

  • Event-driven architecture and Kafka

  • CQRS

  • Mutation testing (PIT, StrykerJS, Muter), treating a surviving mutant as a missing assertion

  • E2E testing with Cypress, Playwright or Karate, and tests that run in ephemeral environments

  • Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals

To Be Considered You'll Need:

- Fluent English

- Your CV/resume submitted in English

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


About the role

CI&T is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with a global enterprise client and ship AI-powered features into its React and .NET operator portal. You will own outcomes end to end: from the first workshop with the client's architects to the code running in production.

A Forward Deployed Engineer is a software engineer first and a consultant second. You work directly with client stakeholders to understand a messy, ambiguous problem, shape the solution, write the production code, and stay until it is adopted. This is not a pre-sales or project management role: you build.

The first mission is to integrate an existing AI assistant into the client's operator portal as a micro frontend, so it runs both inside the portal and as a standalone app. The portal serves frontline and site management teams at large scale.

What you will do

  • Discover with the client. Run working sessions with the client's architects, product owners and frontline users to map workflows, constraints and the highest-value problems.

  • Build and ship production code. Design and deliver micro frontends in React and TypeScript, and the .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) services and APIs behind them.

  • Own the integration contract. Define how the AI assistant plugs into the host portal: module loading, shared state, routing, user and site context, and versioning, so both sides can deploy independently.

  • Handle identity and security. Implement single sign-on across identity providers (for example Entra ID and OneLogin), with role-based access and secure token handling.

  • Make it production-ready. Set up telemetry, accessibility, responsive UX, CI/CD and automated tests, and take part in production deployment and hypercare.

  • Prototype fast. Turn open questions into working prototypes in days, so the client decides on evidence rather than slides.

  • Close the loop. Feed what you learn in the field back into the solution and into CI&T's reusable assets, and help shape the next phases of scope.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, with code you shipped to production and supported.

  • Strong React and TypeScript, including state management, performance and component architecture in large applications.

  • Hands-on micro frontend experience in production (for example Module Federation or single-spa), or a clear account of how you split and integrated a large front end.

  • Solid .NET backend experience: C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs and integration with enterprise systems.

  • Working knowledge of SSO and identity standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) in enterprise environments.

  • CI/CD, automated testing and cloud deployment, preferably on Azure.

  • Advanced English, spoken and written. You will lead workshops, present trade-offs and negotiate scope directly with international stakeholders.

  • Proven client-facing experience: you have worked directly with business or technical stakeholders outside your own team.

Nice to have

  • Python, especially for AI work: calling LLM APIs, building agents or RAG pipelines.

  • Experience building user interfaces for AI assistants or chatbots (streaming responses, conversation history, feedback capture).

  • Familiarity with agent platforms and protocols such as MCP, Copilot Studio or Agentforce.

  • Exposure to Databricks or other enterprise data platforms.

  • Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

  • Experience with apps used by frontline or mobile workforces, including accessibility requirements.

  • Spanish or French.

Who thrives in this role

You are comfortable starting without a complete spec. You ask the questions that turn an ambiguous request into a clear plan, then you build it.

  • You explain a technical trade-off to an architect and to a business user, and both leave with the same decision.

  • You prefer showing a working prototype over writing a long document.

  • You own the result, not just the ticket: if the feature is not adopted, you find out why.

  • You care about cost and scale, because the solution serves hundreds of thousands of users.

In the first 90 days, success means the client has a working micro frontend integration in a test environment, an agreed integration contract between both teams, and a clear plan for production rollout.

Logistics

  • Location: remote from Brazil, with occasional on-site sessions when the project calls for them.

  • Schedule: regular overlap with European business hours (CET), since key client stakeholders are based in Europe.

  • Working language: English with the client; Portuguese within the CI&T team.

  • Start: as soon as possible.

Job Purpose
The CI&T Junior IT Support Analyst is an entry-level member of our Global IT department, dedicated to supporting end users in resolving technical problems promptly and accurately. Working alongside senior analysts, you will build hands-on experience with our end-user technology, tools, and processes.
To succeed in this role, you should enjoy helping people, communicate clearly, follow established procedures and global compliance, security standards, and be eager to learn. We value a solid technical foundation and a problem-solving mindset more than years of experience.
 
Job Type
Full-time, permanent, fully on-site at London, UK.
 
Responsibilities
As a Junior IT Support Analyst, your focus is responding to technical queries and issues, resolving first-level problems promptly, and escalating more complex cases to senior team members.
Respond to end-user requests through the ticketing system (Jira Service Management), logging, prioritizing, and following up on tickets until they are resolved
Troubleshoot and resolve first-level issues with desktops, laptops, peripherals, software, internet, email, and user accounts, escalating complex cases to senior analysts
Install, configure, and update hardware and software following documented procedures
Perform user administration tasks such as account creation, password resets, and access changes in Active Directory and Google Workspace
Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including equipment setup, both remotely and in person
Assist with device management and software deployment in Endpoint Central, under the guidance of senior analysts
Keep the IT asset inventory in Jira Assets accurate and up to date, recording every device assignment, return, and status change
Keep technical documentation, user guides, and knowledge base articles up to date
Communicate technical information to users in a clear, friendly manner
Help identify recurring problems and contribute to checklists and process improvements
Follow global information security and compliance standards in all support activities

Knowledge and Experience
Experience
0 to 1 year of experience in IT support, help desk, or a similar customer-facing role (internships, apprenticeships, and academic projects count)
Customer service mindset and a willingness to help others
Good communication skills in English, written and verbal
Familiarity with Windows 10 and 11; basic knowledge of macOS and Linux (Ubuntu) is a plus
Familiarity with everyday platforms such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Zoom
Basic understanding of networking (Wi-Fi, DNS, VPN) and hardware troubleshooting
Exposure to Jira Service Management or other ticketing systems, Active Directory, Mobile Device Management (MDM), or endpoint management tools
Willingness to learn, follow documented procedures, and work under guidance while building toward working independently
Education
Degree or diploma in IT or a related field (completed or in progress), or equivalent practical experience
Entry-level certifications such as CompTIA A+, Google IT Support, or ITIL Foundation are a plus, but not required

Personal Attributes
Clear and friendly communication
Customer service orientation
Strong integrity and work ethic
Commitment to compliance and information security
Collaboration and teamwork
Adaptability
Curiosity and eagerness to learn
Openness to feedback and coaching
Proactive, problem-solving mindset
Global mindset

Olá, aqui é a Wal da CI&T!
Sou do time de Talent Attraction e estou em busca de profissionais localizados no Brasil para atuar como AI Engineer Mid-level.
Você será responsável por arquitetar e construir a solução de software que atende à demanda do cliente, em qualquer stack, da arquitetura ao código testado, usando o agentic SDLC como forma de trabalho e a IA como principal alavanca de construção, e permanecendo responsável pela aplicação entregue em produção. 
Responsabilidade:
Arquitetar e construir a solução de software que atende à demanda do cliente, em qualquer stack, da arquitetura ao código testado, usando o agentic SDLC como forma de trabalho e a IA como principal alavanca de construção, e permanecendo responsável pela aplicação entregue em produção.
Construir, customizar e orquestrar os próprios agentes, skills, subagentes, comandos e harness que aceleram a construção da aplicação, reaproveitando-os no time, em vez de consumir assistentes de forma passiva, impulsionando a modernização contínua dos processos e das práticas de desenvolvimento de software, e reduzindo o tempo entre construir e entregar (lead time).
Dominar e aplicar fundamentos modernos de arquitetura e engenharia de software (microsserviços, sistemas orientados a eventos, filas, CI/CD, TDD e automação) para construir, avaliar e criticar o código e as soluções geradas.
Traduzir os requisitos funcionais em uma solução técnica viável, simples e escalável, exercendo escolhas intencionais, sem aceitar passivamente as sugestões da IA, para evitar over-engineering.
Projetar e avaliar com evals, testes e red teaming (alucinações, injeções e vazamentos) tanto a solução quanto os agentes e skills que constrói, de forma a validar o comportamento probabilístico da solução antes da entrega.
Tomar decisões de token economy no design da solução (tamanho de contexto, estratégia de RAG e número de chamadas de agentes), para equilibrar qualidade e custo de inferência.
Quando a solução inclui componente de IA, arquitetar e construir a solução agêntica: agentes via API com RAG, orquestração de ferramentas, frameworks de orquestração e runtime, e system prompts e guardrails na aplicação.
Quando a solução inclui componente de IA, gerenciar a engenharia e os pipelines de dados de contexto, estruturando a integração de fontes internas e de bases de dados vetoriais para alimentar os sistemas agênticos com insumos confiáveis e de alta qualidade.
Implementar a instrumentação de observabilidade no código da aplicação e dos agentes, monitorando continuamente o comportamento do sistema para agir sobre anomalias e degradações.
Revisar e criticar os outputs gerados por IA, assegurando aderência aos requisitos técnicos, de qualidade e de negócio antes da entrega.
Delegar tarefas especializadas aos agentes construídos, atuando com visão generalista ao longo de toda a esteira de desenvolvimento, enquanto sustenta a profundidade técnica e autoridade na sua stack de especialidade para avaliar e validar criticamente os outputs.
Entregar a solução em estado apto para produção, alinhado com o AI Deployment Engineer sobre requisitos de deploy e operação.
Aplicar as práticas de ética, privacidade, segurança de dados e conformidade, para manter as soluções dentro das regras do cliente e da CI&T.
Aprofundar a autonomia técnica conduzindo soluções de complexidade moderada, com supervisão reduzida.
Desenvolver a aplicação de ponta a ponta em soluções de complexidade moderada, respondendo pela entrega em produção.
Ampliar o tooling próprio com subagentes e harness e impulsionar a modernização das práticas de desenvolvimento.
Desenhar e desenvolver a solução agêntica de ponta a ponta em cenários de complexidade moderada, incluindo engenharia e pipelines de dados de contexto (fontes internas e bases de dados vetoriais).
Integrar sistemas e desenhar APIs para consumo por outros serviços e times.
Conduzir o red teaming da solução e dos agentes (alucinações, injeções e vazamentos), complementando os evals e os testes.
Criticar e questionar alternativas de design, evitando over-engineering e avaliando quando usar soluções de mercado.
Instrumentar e acompanhar a observabilidade no código da aplicação e dos agentes, monitorando comportamento, qualidade e custo.
 
Requisitos:
Applied AI Engineering
AI Agent Engineering
Software Engineering
AI Infrastructure
RAG and Retrieval
Tool Use and Orchestration
Evals and Testing
Data Engineering
Context Engineering
AI Fluency
Knowledge Graphs (Property Graph, RDF)
Advanced RAG Architectures
AI Red Teaming
 
Mais do que conhecimento técnico, buscamos alguém com atitude e protagonismo!
Perfil proativo, hands-on e com forte senso de ownership.
Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente.
Iniciativa para identificar problemas, propor soluções e antecipar necessidades.
Forte vontade de fazer acontecer, tirar ideias do papel e transformar desafios em entregas concretas.
Autonomia para destravar problemas e fazer as coisas andarem, sem depender de direcionamentos constantes
Curiosidade e disposição para experimentar, aprender e explorar novas tecnologia.

Responsabilidade:

  • Arquitetar e construir a solução de software que atende à demanda do cliente, em qualquer stack, da arquitetura ao código testado, usando o agentic SDLC como forma de trabalho e a IA como principal alavanca de construção, e permanecendo responsável pela aplicação entregue em produção.
  • Construir, customizar e orquestrar os próprios agentes, skills, subagentes, comandos e harness que aceleram a construção da aplicação, reaproveitando-os no time, em vez de consumir assistentes de forma passiva, impulsionando a modernização contínua dos processos e das práticas de desenvolvimento de software, e reduzindo o tempo entre construir e entregar (lead time).
  • Dominar e aplicar fundamentos modernos de arquitetura e engenharia de software (microsserviços, sistemas orientados a eventos, filas, CI/CD, TDD e automação) para construir, avaliar e criticar o código e as soluções geradas.
  • Traduzir os requisitos funcionais em uma solução técnica viável, simples e escalável, exercendo escolhas intencionais, sem aceitar passivamente as sugestões da IA, para evitar over-engineering.
  • Projetar e avaliar com evals, testes e red teaming (alucinações, injeções e vazamentos) tanto a solução quanto os agentes e skills que constrói, de forma a validar o comportamento probabilístico da solução antes da entrega.
  • Tomar decisões de token economy no design da solução (tamanho de contexto, estratégia de RAG e número de chamadas de agentes), para equilibrar qualidade e custo de inferência.
  • Quando a solução inclui componente de IA, arquitetar e construir a solução agêntica: agentes via API com RAG, orquestração de ferramentas, frameworks de orquestração e runtime, e system prompts e guardrails na aplicação.
  • Quando a solução inclui componente de IA, gerenciar a engenharia e os pipelines de dados de contexto, estruturando a integração de fontes internas e de bases de dados vetoriais para alimentar os sistemas agênticos com insumos confiáveis e de alta qualidade.
  • Implementar a instrumentação de observabilidade no código da aplicação e dos agentes, monitorando continuamente o comportamento do sistema para agir sobre anomalias e degradações.
  • Revisar e criticar os outputs gerados por IA, assegurando aderência aos requisitos técnicos, de qualidade e de negócio antes da entrega.
  • Delegar tarefas especializadas aos agentes construídos, atuando com visão generalista ao longo de toda a esteira de desenvolvimento, enquanto sustenta a profundidade técnica e autoridade na sua stack de especialidade para avaliar e validar criticamente os outputs.
  • Entregar a solução em estado apto para produção, alinhado com o AI Deployment Engineer sobre requisitos de deploy e operação.
  • Aplicar as práticas de ética, privacidade, segurança de dados e conformidade, para manter as soluções dentro das regras do cliente e da CI&T.
  • Definir e liderar o design de solução de problemas complexos, elevando a qualidade técnica do time.

  • Responder pela solução de ponta a ponta em cenários complexos (múltiplos sistemas, integrações e modelos), da arquitetura à entrega em produção.

  • Estabelecer e reutilizar no time (não só para si) os agentes, skills e harness.

  • Estruturar frameworks de orquestração e runtime, garantindo insumos e comportamento confiáveis em escala.

  • Orientar decisões de prompt engineering, evals e red teaming em escala.

  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor de pares, revisando código e padrões.

  • Colaborar com o AI Deployment Engineer e o AI Orchestrator, disponibilizando blocos e infraestrutura prontos.
 

Requisitos:

  • Applied AI Engineering
  • AI Agent Engineering
  • Software Engineering
  • AI Infrastructure
  • RAG and Retrieval
  • Tool Use and Orchestration
  • Evals and Testing
  • Data Engineering
  • Context Engineering
  • AI Fluency
  • Knowledge Graphs (Property Graph, RDF)
  • Advanced RAG Architectures
  • AI Red Teaming

 

Mais do que conhecimento técnico, buscamos alguém com atitude e protagonismo!

  • Perfil proativo, hands-on e com forte senso de ownership.

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente.

  • Iniciativa para identificar problemas, propor soluções e antecipar necessidades.

  • Forte vontade de fazer acontecer, tirar ideias do papel e transformar desafios em entregas concretas.

  • Autonomia para destravar problemas e fazer as coisas andarem, sem depender de direcionamentos constantes

  • Curiosidade e disposição para experimentar, aprender e explorar novas tecnologia.

A Box1824 atua há 25 anos como referência em estudos de comportamento, cultura e tendências aplicados à construção de estratégias de negócios para clientes brasileiros e globais.

Agora, estamos consolidando nossa atuação como uma Behaviour Business Company e buscamos uma liderança estratégica para atuar exatamente na intersecção entre o universo de negócios e o de estudos de comportamento.

O que buscamos: 

  • Sólida experiência em estratégia de negócios, com passagem por consultorias (estratégia, inovação ou operações), áreas estratégicas de grandes empresas (marketing, growth, inovação, transformação digital, venture building) ou startups - vivências em múltiplos desses setores e mercados são muito bem-vindas;

  • Domínio na estruturação e decupagem de problemas complexos, formulação de hipóteses, análise de cenários (macroeconômicos, de mercados e competitivos), sizing e estimativas de potencial de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de expansão e desenho de alavancas de crescimento;

  • Experiência na liderança de times multidisciplinares e na condução de discussões com C-level;

  • Autonomia, curiosidade para se aprofundar em diferentes temas e mercados, responsabilidade pelas entregas, compromisso com impacto nos clientes e excelente comunicação escrita e verbal.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia com pesquisas de mercado (quali e quanti), estudos de comportamento e tendências - caso não tenha essa bagagem, buscamos pessoas com interesse em aprender e aplicar os conceitos, metodologias, frameworks e repertórios proprietários da Box1824.

 

No dia a dia, você será responsável por: 

  • Liderar projetos estratégicos de ponta a ponta para grandes clientes: compreensão dos seus desafios de negócio, condução de metodologias de diagnóstico, decodificação dos resultados e desenho de estratégias de negócio e futuro; 

  • Traduzir insights comportamentais e culturais em decisões práticas de produto, portfólio, pricing, canais, experiência, modelo de negócio e posicionamento;

  • Construir narrativas executivas que traduzam cenários e problemas complexos em sínteses estratégicas precisas e acionáveis;

  • Liderar times multidisciplinares, promovendo processos de construção coletiva com a equipe interna e clientes;  

  • Conduzir fóruns e agendas estratégicas com C-level, apoiando tomadas de decisão de alta complexidade e impacto;

  • Conduzir o relacionamento com clientes, identificar novas oportunidades e apoiar o desenho de propostas para novos negócios.

About the Role
We are looking for a Presales Technical Consultant – Big Data & Databricks who combines strong technical expertise in modern data platforms with excellent client-facing and presales capabilities.
In this role, you will serve as a key technical bridge between our sales teams, global clients, and delivery organizations. You will lead the technical aspects of the presales lifecycle—from business and technical discovery, solution architecture, estimation, and proposal development to Proof of Concept (POC) and delivery handover.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience delivering Databricks and large-scale data engineering projects, a strong understanding of modern cloud data architectures, and proven experience working with global enterprise clients and distributed teams.

We are looking for a Presales Technical Consultant – Big Data & Databricks who combines strong technical expertise in modern data platforms with excellent client-facing and presales capabilities.
In this role, you will serve as a key technical bridge between our sales teams, global clients, and delivery organizations. You will lead the technical aspects of the presales lifecycle—from business and technical discovery, solution architecture, estimation, and proposal development to Proof of Concept (POC) and delivery handover.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience delivering Databricks and large-scale data engineering projects, a strong understanding of modern cloud data architectures, and proven experience working with global enterprise clients and distributed teams.

lists.content:
I. Customer Discovery & Solution Design

  • Lead technical and business discovery sessions with enterprise clients to understand their business objectives, existing data landscape, technical challenges, and transformation priorities.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable big data, data engineering, analytics, and cloud data platform solutions.
  • Design end-to-end solution architectures covering areas such as:
  • Data ingestion and integration
  • Data lake and lakehouse architecture
  • Batch and real-time data processing
  • Data transformation and orchestration
  • Data modeling and analytics
  • Data governance, security, and access control
  • Cloud data platform modernization and migration
  • Design solutions leveraging Databricks and related cloud data services across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Assess clients' existing data platforms and recommend practical modernization and migration approaches based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, and cost.

    • II. Technical Presales & Solution Demonstration

  • Develop and present tailored solution proposals, architecture designs, and technical demonstrations based on specific client requirements and industry scenarios.
  • Communicate both high-level business value and detailed technical solutions to different audiences, including C-level executives, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.
  • Lead technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, ensuring proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially competitive, and aligned with client requirements.
  • Lead or support Proof of Concept (POC) and technical validation activities to demonstrate solution feasibility and business value.
  • Conduct technical workshops, architecture discussions, and solution review sessions with global clients.
  • Support effort estimation, technical scope definition, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery planning during the presales process.

    • III. Presales Project Management

  • End-to-End Presales Management: Own the technical presales lifecycle from requirements discovery and solution architecture through proposal submission and delivery handover.
  • Multi-Opportunity Management: Manage multiple client opportunities at different stages and prioritize activities based on deal value, strategic importance, complexity, and deadlines.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Cloud, Data, and Project Management teams to develop feasible and competitive solutions.
  • Bid & Proposal Management: Lead technical activities throughout the bid process, including requirements analysis, solution architecture, estimation, compliance review, risk identification, and final submission.
  • Handover Management: Ensure a smooth transition from presales to implementation teams, with clear documentation of scope, architecture, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and client expectations.

    • IV. Global Client Engagement & Technology Leadership

  • Work directly with global enterprise clients, collaborating across different regions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Build trusted technical relationships with client architects, engineering leaders, data teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Work effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams across different countries and regions.
  • Partner with internal Engineering, Delivery, Product, and Business teams to identify reusable solution patterns, accelerators, and best practices.
  • Provide technical enablement and knowledge sharing to sales, presales, and delivery teams.
  • Stay current with developments in Databricks, cloud data platforms, lakehouse architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML technologies.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable reference architectures, solution frameworks, technical assets, and industry-specific offerings.

Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or presales roles, with significant experience designing complex enterprise data solutions.
  • Proven experience working in a technical presales, solution architecture, or client-facing consulting role.
  • Hands-on project experience with Databricks, preferably involving production-scale implementations rather than only training, certification, or POC environments.
  • Experience designing or delivering large-scale data engineering, data lake, lakehouse, or cloud data platform solutions.
  • Proven experience working directly with global enterprise clients, including technical workshops, solution discussions, presentations, and stakeholder management.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed delivery and engineering teams across multiple regions.

    • Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of modern big data and data engineering architectures.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Databricks, including key concepts such as:
  • Delta Lake
  • Lakehouse architecture
  • Spark-based data processing
  • Data pipelines and orchestration
  • Databricks SQL
  • Unity Catalog and data governance
  • Strong understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, and data integration patterns.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native data services, data warehouses, object storage, messaging, orchestration, and analytics technologies.
  • Understanding of enterprise data governance, security, access control, data quality, and compliance principles.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integration patterns, and modern data ecosystem components.
  • Ability to design scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective enterprise data architectures.

    • Presales & Project Management Skills

  • Proven experience managing technical activities throughout the presales lifecycle, from discovery and solution design to proposal and delivery handover.
  • Strong experience with RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, bid management, solution estimation, and technical proposal development.
  • Experience leading technical workshops, architecture reviews, and POCs.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong ability to identify solution risks, assumptions, dependencies, and technical trade-offs.

    • Communication & Influence

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with international clients and teams.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business outcomes.
  • Confident engaging with stakeholders at different levels, from engineers and architects to senior management and C-level executives.
  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.

• Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Databricks certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer, Data Engineer Professional, or related certifications.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms, particularly AWS and Azure.
  • Experience with technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar modern data platforms.
  • Experience in enterprise data platform modernization or migration programs.
  • Understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, and their integration with enterprise data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and CCPA.
  • Experience working in consulting, system integration, or global technology service organizations.
  • Relevant cloud certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Databricks.
